credit.extension: Override GroupRuntime.make_credit(cfg) -> subclass with own protocol/schema and parts(components); same object used for finalize and boundary/rank recompute
credit.extra_material: Nonstandard material must use a paired custom finalizer and validator; recovery.validate_structure is available without assuming any A mathematics.

trainer_hooks.bind_training_state: after native restore before Invocation/first stream.at
trainer_hooks.on_collection_committed: after A finalize and collections/exposure/cursor commit, before boundary check/behavior publication; once per fresh collection; exceptions gathered before any rank enters validation/publication
trainer_hooks.public_training_state: full native state preserved; large curriculum fields removed only from public summaries
trainer_hooks.stop: runtime.request_stop callback bound to local trainer.stop; avoids duplicate __main__ module flags

checkpoint.hooks: runtime.validate_boundary and validate_ranks supplied on BOTH save and restore
checkpoint.states: full Adam/scheduler/all RNG/source generator/rollout/curriculum per-rank; no G8-to-G16 native resume
checkpoint.identity: scope schema retained for deployment compatibility; exploration/credit/condition protocols explicit; JSON-canonicalized before sealing

dependencies.adaptive_owned: curriculum mixin/stream; append boundary/rank state checks
